purpose: Decision-specific FIE V9 forward-validation contract. Projection accuracy alone cannot activate every fantasy decision domain.
promotion_requirements: paired temporal evaluation against the same baseline rows
positive paired temporal-block bootstrap lower confidence bound
decision regret no worse than baseline when available
fail closed when required samples or temporal periods are unavailable
selection_policy: Feature/model selection and final evaluation must be temporally separated or nested. Do not promote the best of many searched candidates on the same final evaluation sample.
